_about: New image descriptions for region 1 (cases 1–10), written for every person, place and object exhibit that had none. Applied to the case files by  node tools/apply-briefs.mjs prompts/briefs/region-01.json . Style rules: design doc §5 (Kenyan, specific, everyday; no readable text, logos, real people, injuries or bodies). Amani is never shown.

noPhoto.ev_scratches: Scratches on a person's hands are an injury, and photos never show injuries (design doc §5): this exhibit stays the examination note.
